attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-api as a systemd-managed service on node1 (RHEL 9), hardened with OOMScoreAdjust=-1000 and OOMPolicy=continue so the kernel OOM-killer never selects it. Verified under a real memory-exhaustion test that a deliberately unprotected memory-hog process (oom_score_adj=0) was the one killed by the kernel while inventory-api kept serving without interruption or restart. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot id and service health, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed the boot id changed, and verified inventory-api came back enabled/active and serving correctly post-reboot.
